The Craft

Nature, worked by hand

Elemental mural art joins natural elements with worked materials — organic clay built into raised relief, copper and iron beaten into line and ornament, glass and pigment set like jewels into the surface.

Each panel is composed the way a temple wall is composed: a dark, textured ground; figures that stand off the surface; gold that carries the image forward while everything else recedes. What is coloured is what matters.

ClayHand-built relief ground, textured and burnished
Copper & IronBeaten metal linework, raised ornament and leaf
Glass & PigmentLustrous inlays of colour set into the dark field
